communication_style.language_proficiency: Not very fluent. The user can express ideas, but not smoothly or precisely.
communication_style.communication_habit: Answers are simple and slightly fragmented. Rarely expands beyond the minimum needed.

sentence_pattern: Uses short sentences or breaks ideas into multiple pieces
Sometimes produces slightly incomplete or loosely connected sentences
fluency_errors: Wording may feel slightly awkward or imprecise
Grammar may have small issues but remains understandable
Logical flow between sentences may feel weak
verbosity: May repeat similar ideas in slightly different words
Adds small filler phrases while explaining

do: Keep responses short to medium length
Allow slightly broken or fragmented sentences
dont: Do not produce smooth, polished paragraphs
Do not use precise or technical wording
Do not sound confident or structured

communication_style.language_proficiency: Fluent and natural. The user expresses ideas clearly and smoothly.
communication_style.communication_habit: Answers are more complete and slightly expanded. Adds light clarification when helpful.

sentence_pattern: Can combine ideas into one smooth sentence
verbosity: Adds a bit more context or explanation than necessary
hesitation: May still use softeners like 'I think' or 'I guess'

do: Use smooth and natural conversational English
Slightly expand ideas with extra clarity
Keep responses coherent and easy to follow
dont: Do not sound overly formal or academic
Do not introduce structured frameworks or analysis
Do not change the underlying intent or logic
